title: Graph neural networks in modern AI-aided drug discovery

fields.title: Graph neural networks in modern AI-aided drug discovery
fields.authors: Zhang, O., Lin, H., Zhang, X., Wang, X., Wu, Z., Ye, Q., Zhao, W., Wang, J., Ying, K.,  Kang, Y., Hsieh, C.-Y., Hou, T.
fields.description: This review covers graph neural networks for molecular property prediction, virtual screening, molecule generation, biomedical knowledge graphs and synthesis planning. It examines model design, integration with other learning methods and limitations in drug discovery applications.

descriptions.text: This review covers graph neural networks for molecular property prediction, virtual screening, molecule generation, biomedical knowledge graphs and synthesis planning.
